Hi Olivia — great to hear and glad the demo landed well. Short answer: yes, we can often support a temporary invoice-only path for short pilots, subject to a few checks and an approval.

What we'll need to move forward: 
- Basic vendor intake: company legal name, billing address, remit-to details
- A W-9 (for US entities) and company contact for invoicing
- Security summary or SOC2 snapshot (if pilot will ingest customer data)

Typical constraints we apply for temporary no-PO pilots: 
- Dollar cap: $15,000 / month (can be lowered/raised with manager approval)
- Duration: up to 3 months for pilots without PO; extensions require procurement review
- We require a PO or contracting step before production rollouts

I'll loop in Marissa (CS lead) to confirm technical guardrails and Laura (my manager) for approval on the cap/duration. If you can send the vendor paperwork (W-9 + security docs) we can start vendor intake and get you on the invoice queue.

Next steps: 
1) Olivia: share W-9 and security summary
2) Redwood: risk intake + manager sign-off on dollar cap
3) Set invoicing contact and remit info

Thanks — Ben

Hi Olivia — Laura Bennett here (Head of Commercial Ops). Ben flagged this thread. We are prepared to approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for Meridian AI under the following conditions: 

1) Duration and cap
- Temporary allowance: up to 3 months total
- Cap: $15,000 per month (pilot month 1), can be re-evaluated after month 1 based on usage and risk

2) Required vendor materials (to be submitted before invoice-only lane is enabled)
- Completed vendor intake form (I’ve attached our short intake note below)
- W-9 (if US entity) or equivalent tax form for non-US entities
- Security summary or SOC2 Type II attestation (redacted is acceptable)

3) Operational controls
- Invoices must be routed to finance@meridianai.com with the correct remit address. Any charge above the cap will be paused until a PO or contract amendment is in place.
- Redwood will add Meridian to a temporary allowlist for billing; this will be visible to your account team.

Please send the requested docs and a remit address. Once we have them, I will sign-off and our Vendor Intake team will create the temporary invoice-only onboarding record.

Attachments referenced: redwood-allowlist-note.txt (text) — includes intake link and who to route invoices to.
